message:
test(update): check the disk, and what moves between enumeration and the wait

Test 1. No product change. Two of the three items the reviewer left open on B1; the third needs
a streaming host and is deliberately not here.

"A lingering child means no swap" was only ever shown as Quiesce returning false. That is the
gate, not the point. The install directory now holds a file with known contents before the
attempt, and it has to be byte for byte the same afterwards -- the refusal is only worth
something if the disk was not touched.

The other two come from a design decision nobody had checked. Quiesce waits for the list
PrepareForSwap worked from rather than a fresh one, which cuts both ways: a child that leaves in
between is not a failure, because leaving is what the wait was for; and a child that ARRIVES in
between is not waited for at all. The second is the one worth having -- a helper started a moment
after the enumeration would otherwise hold an update open for its whole lifetime. Measured at 0ms
against a twenty second budget.

Everything here spawns this test's own executable in its fixture modes. Nothing starts a streaming
host and nothing captures a screen.

53 checks, three runs clean, up from 46.

Still open, and not startable right now: reproducing the trigger against a host actually running
in GDI capture mode. That needs GNLinkStream and a capture worker, which the user has asked about
-- I have been starting those repeatedly for the end-to-end work, and they are paused until the
user says how they want it handled.
